# Senkronla

> Open-source, self-hosted Envelope Sync Relay for offline-first applications — integrate via JavaScript SDK or REST API.

Senkronla stores opaque ESR-DOC1 envelopes and coordinates multi-device sync. Spec **v1.3** adds optional application registry (`X-ESR-App-Id`, namespace–app binding). Spec v1.2 supports multiple named documents per namespace (`primary`, `settings`, etc.) via `EsrSync.connect({ documents: [...] })` and `/documents/{documentId}/...` REST paths.

Production payloads use **ENV-ENC1** envelope encryption (PBKDF2-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM). The **sync password** is app-provided — never sent to the relay — and is separate from the 24-word recovery phrase.

When the relay operator enables **app registry** (`apps.enabled`), integrations must send `X-ESR-App-Id` (+ web `Origin` or native bundle headers). Namespaces are bound to the creating app. Spec: [16-APP-REGISTRY.md](https://github.com/kemalersin/senkronla/blob/main/docs/en/16-APP-REGISTRY.md).
